name: Is it possible to match existing tiles for repair?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to match existing tiles for repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching existing tiles for repair can be challenging but is often possible. Contractors will first try to source identical tiles if the original manufacturer and color/style are known and still available. If not, they may look for close matches from various suppliers or salvaged materials. For very unique or discontinued tiles, a repair might involve using a contrasting but complementary tile, or in some cases, custom fabrication may be explored, though this is significantly more expensive. Always keep spare tiles from the original installation if possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Matching existing tiles is often possible by sourcing identical tiles or close alternatives. Keep spare tiles if you have them.
